awards.name: Best of Award of Excellence - Two Glasses

bio: Métier, a Michelin-starred restaurant in Washington, D.C., offers an intimate and refined dining experience that blends French technique with modern American sensibilities. Opened in 2017 by chef-owner Eric Ziebold and his wife and partner Célia Laurent, Métier serves as a more formal counterpart to their acclaimed restaurant Kinship, located just above it. Guests are welcomed into a warm, elegantly designed space that feels more like a private home than a traditional dining room, setting the stage for a highly personal culinary journey. The multi-course tasting menu showcases Ziebold's meticulous craftsmanship, featuring dishes that highlight seasonal ingredients prepared with precision and creativity, often weaving in global influences while maintaining a focus on balance and harmony. Each course is presented with an eye for detail and storytelling, paired with a thoughtfully curated wine and beverage program that enhances the flavors of the meal. With its combination of sophistication, intimacy, and artistry, Métier offers a dining experience that is both memorable and transportive, reaffirming Ziebold's reputation as one of the city's most celebrated chefs.
